thread:
Leah (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. I promised a thread for questions on the headcount plan and reorg. I'll start: we are reallocating ~14 FTEs over the next quarter mostly from infra to product/observability. Details below, ask here.

Ravi (Head of People): Short summary: no company-wide hiring freeze. We're pausing some reqs in infra ops and accelerating hires in platform, runtime, and product infra. Net +10 headcount for 2026 plan after reallocation. Link: <https://redwood-internal/docs/org/headcount-q1-2026>

Sam (VP Eng): To clarify — this is not layoffs. We're repurposing open reqs and shifting team ownerships for reliability investments. Several team leads will move to new reporting lines (eng-platform -> eng-runtime). I'll DM affected managers today. :wave:

Maya (Platform Eng): Who is the new manager for the caching squad? I heard about a lead being moved.

Sam (VP Eng): Jordan will be interim for caching squad for 6-8 weeks while we recruit a principal. Jordan (Product) will post candidate profile and hiring timeline tomorrow.

Jordan (Product): Posting profile at EOD, feedback welcome. We're focusing SRE + product pairing skills — code + observability experience.

Tom (SRE): Any SLA or oncall changes? Our rotation already has gaps.

Sam (VP Eng): Short term — no SLA changes. We're funding two extra SRE headcount for Q2 to close rotation gaps. If you have specific oncall pain points add them to the doc or ping me.

Maya (Platform Eng): Thanks. Also, will existing hiring pipelines be preserved (refs, candidates in process)?

Ravi (Head of People): Yes — active candidates won't be dropped. We're reassigning recruiters to priority roles. If your hiring manager is impacted we'll introduce the new owner and transfer candidate notes.

Leah (CEO): Quick ask from leadership: keep interviewing for greenlighted reqs. For impacted roles, pause only if you hear from recruiting. We want continuity. :thumbsup:

Maya (Platform Eng): Understood, thanks

Jordan (Product): FYI — planning a 30-min sync next week for affected squads. Invite to follow.

Tom (SRE): Can we get an org chart snapshot? Hard to picture changes.

Ravi (Head of People): Will upload updated org chart and a one-page FAQ to the doc by EOD. Will include manager changes, reporting lines, and hiring prioritization matrix.

Maya (Platform Eng): Appreciated.

Sam (VP Eng): One more note — Dedicated and Private product timelines are unchanged. This reorg is to better align infra investments to those roadmaps.

Maya (Platform Eng): Cool

Leah (CEO): If anyone wants to raise confidential concerns, please DM Ravi or me. We'll do manager office hours next Wed. Thanks all. :heart:

deploy-bot: Deployed doc: headcount-plan-2026.pdf (sha256: abc123...)

Maya (Platform Eng): Adding a couple questions in the doc about leveling and IC->manager tracks.

Ravi (Head of People): We'll address leveling in the FAQ.

Jordan (Product): Will share the candidate scorecard template with hiring managers tomorrow.

Tom (SRE): Thanks everyone

Leah (CEO): Closing thread — we might follow up in next all-hands with more detail. Keep questions coming.
